events.title: Freddie Mercury: 35 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: November 24th marks 35 years since the world lost the iconic Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: 35 years ago today, we lost one of music's most electrifying performers. Freddie Mercury's legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965, featuring classics like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life'.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 61 years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul'. Still sounds as fresh and innovative as it did in '65. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: December 8th marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to resonate worldwide.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the birth of the legendary David Bowie, who would have turned 80 on January 8, 2027.

angles.name: Bowie's Legacy Lives On
angles.copy: The Starman would have been 80 today. David Bowie, forever pushing boundaries and inspiring us all.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: On January 8, 2027, we remember the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have celebrated his 92nd birthday.

angles.name: The King's Birthday
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today. Still shaking up the airwaves and our hearts. Long live Elvis!

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Legendary Led Zeppelin guitarist Jimmy Page celebrates his 83rd birthday on January 9, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Jimmy Page
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the maestro, Jimmy Page! What's your favourite Led Zeppelin riff?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer, celebrates his 82nd birthday on January 10, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rod The Mod
angles.copy: Still rocking after all these years! Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Rod Stewart.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the lead singer of Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday on January 13, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Suggs
angles.copy: One Step Beyond 65! Happy 66th birthday to the brilliant Suggs, frontman of Madness.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British pop icon Paul Young, known for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat', celebrates his 71st birthday on January 17, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Paul Young
angles.copy: Wherever he lays his hat, that's his home! Wishing a very happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: The legendary Queen of Country, Dolly Parton, celebrates her 81st birthday on January 19, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Dolly
angles.copy: Still working 9 to 5 and looking fabulous! Happy 81st birthday to the incomparable Dolly Parton.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday on January 20, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Gary Barlow
angles.copy: Still shining bright! Wishing a very happy 56th birthday to Take That's very own Gary Barlow.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer Billy Ocean, known for his 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday on January 21, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Billy Ocean
angles.copy: Get outta his dreams, get into his car... and wish Billy Ocean a very happy 77th birthday!

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame's First Induction 38 Years Ago
events.blurb: On January 24, 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its inaugural induction ceremony, honouring legends like The Beatles, Elvis Presley, and Chuck Berry.

angles.name: Rock History Made
angles.copy: 38 years ago, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame opened its doors to the first class of legends. Who was your favourite inaugural inductee?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday on January 27, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Mark Owen
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to the charming Mark Owen! Still bringing the magic with Take That.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert: 58 Years On
events.blurb: On January 30, 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Rockers
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Grammy-winning musician Phil Collins, known for his solo hits and work with Genesis, celebrates his 76th birthday on January 30, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Phil Collins
angles.copy: Another year, another beat! Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins. What's your favourite solo hit?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday on January 31, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Justin Timberlake
angles.copy: From boy band heartthrob to solo superstar, Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake!

events.title: The Day The Music Died: 68 Years On
events.blurb: February 3, 1959, marks 'The Day The Music Died' as Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Remembering Music Legends
angles.copy: 68 years ago, we lost three giants of early rock and roll. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper today.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: British pop sensation Rick Astley, known for 'Never Gonna Give You Up', celebrates his 61st birthday on February 6, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Rick Astley
angles.copy: He's never gonna give you up, and we're never gonna give up celebrating his birthday! Happy 61st to Rick Astley.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: On February 6, 2027, we honour the birth of reggae icon Bob Marley, who would have been 82.

angles.name: Celebrating Bob Marley
angles.copy: One love, one heart, one legend. Celebrating Bob Marley's enduring spirit on what would have been his 82nd birthday.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter Carole King, known for 'Tapestry', celebrates her 85th birthday on February 9, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Carole King
angles.copy: You've Got a Friend in her music! Wishing a very happy 85th birthday to the incredible Carole King.

events.title: Whitney Houston: 15 Years Since Her Passing
events.blurb: February 11, 2027, marks 15 years since the world lost the incomparable voice of Whitney Houston.

angles.name: Remembering Whitney
angles.copy: 15 years ago, we said goodbye to 'The Voice'. Whitney Houston's incredible talent and music live on.

events.title: Take That Split Anniversary: 32 Years On
events.blurb: February 13, 2027, marks 32 years since the original split of British pop group Take That, breaking millions of hearts.

angles.name: Never Forget The Split
angles.copy: 32 years ago, the pop world changed forever. Remembering the day Take That first said 'Bye Bye Baby'.

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40, celebrates his 68th birthday on February 15, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ali Campbell
angles.copy: Red, Red Wine and a happy 68th birthday to UB40's Ali Campbell! Still bringing the reggae vibes.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Global pop superstar Ed Sheeran celebrates his 36th birthday on February 17, 2027.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Ed Sheeran
angles.copy: Thinking Out Loud, it's Ed Sheeran's 36th birthday! Here's to more chart-topping tunes.
